visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black button-up long-sleeved crop top and light blue jeans with purple heart patches, stands in a bedroom. She holds a large pink fitted sheet. The room has a bed with a beige headboard and a white wall with warm lighting. She gestures with her right hand while holding the sheet. (2) She moves to the bed, laying the pink sheet out. She demonstrates a folding technique by tucking the corners into each other. She is leaning over the bed, using her hands to align the elastic edges. The background shows a white dresser with various items and a clothing rack. (3) The camera angle shifts as she continues to fold the pink sheet into a smaller, neat rectangle on the bed. She uses smoothing hand motions. She then folds it again into a perfect square. Her expression is focused yet cheerful. (4) She picks up a floral patterned pillowcase and shows how to stuff the folded pink sheet and other matching bedding items inside it. She holds up the final compact bundle to the camera, smiling and waving to sign off.
